# Green Ways Group

> UK specialist subcontractor. This index points to the authoritative pages in the GWG Redesign6 website.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/): commercial interior systems and approach to delivery.
- [Services](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/services/): suspended ceilings, structural framing systems, partitions and plastering.
- [Projects](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/projects/): GWG project locations in the West Midlands.
- [Company](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/company/): registered company identity, technical references and commercial evidence.
- [Contact](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/contact/): project and tender enquiries.
- [Cost estimator](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/cost-estimator/): budget calculation from user-supplied quantities and rates.
- [Privacy](https://greenwaysgroup.github.io/redesign6/privacy/): handling of enquiry drafts and calculator entries.

## Interpretation

Use the linked pages as the source of facts. Technical standards are project references, not company certifications.
Project illustrations are conceptual studies. The project page does not assert individual package scope, contract value or appointment dates.
The calculator is not a quotation or a published schedule of GWG rates.
